scripts.logs:import-file: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws logs tail /aws/lambda/importProductsFile --follow --format short
scripts.logs:import-parser: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws logs tail /aws/lambda/importFileParser --follow --format short
scripts.logs:products-list: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws logs tail /aws/lambda/getProductsList --follow --format short
scripts.logs:products-by-id: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws logs tail /aws/lambda/getProductsById --follow --format short
scripts.logs:create-product: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws logs tail /aws/lambda/createProduct --follow --format short
scripts.logs:batch: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws logs tail /aws/lambda/catalogBatchProcess --follow --format short
scripts.outputs: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name ProductServiceStack --query "Stacks[0].Outputs" --output table && npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name ImportServiceStack --query "Stacks[0].Outputs" --output table
scripts.outputs:json: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name ProductServiceStack --query "Stacks[0].Outputs" --output json && npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name ImportServiceStack --query "Stacks[0].Outputs" --output json
